metadata.description: A growing collection of Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: course-notes
plugins.description: Turn online course transcripts into structured study notes in Notion and/or Markdown.

plugins.name: learning-calendar
plugins.description: Log what you learned today to a Notion calendar, from your Claude sessions and your own list, after you approve the topics.

plugins.name: brand-palette
plugins.description: Build an accessible light and dark brand color palette, checked for contrast and color blindness, as a swatch board with plain-language notes.

plugins.name: ship-pr
plugins.description: Commit, sync with main (resolving merge conflicts), push and open a GitHub pull request after checking the repo, branch and changes. Never merges or pushes to main.
